title: Weekly TSS by Discipline Balance
dataSources: TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), Garmin multisport activities (`garmin:multisport`), TriDot plans (`tridot:plan`), brick workouts (`brick:workout`), and transition logs (`transition:log`).
app: TrainingPeaks structured workouts, Garmin multisport FIT exports, TriDot training plans, brick workout logs, and transition timing notes ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trainingpeaks:workout sport=* tss=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(tss) as weekly_tss by _time sport
| chart sum(weekly_tss) over _time by sport
description: Breaks down weekly Training Stress Score totals by swim, bike, and run discipline.
value: Discipline imbalance is a common overuse-injury path; a weekly TSS split keeps load proportional.
implementation: Ensure each TrainingPeaks workout carries `sport` and `tss`, then review the weekly stacked chart.
visualization: Stacked column chart of weekly TSS by sport.
grandmaExplanation: It watches whether your training load is balanced across swim, bike, and run each week.
